title: Doubly Linked List Insertion at Given Position
description:
Given a doubly-linked list, a position p, and an integer x. The task is to add a new node with value x at the position just after pth node in the doubly-linked list (0-indexed).

Input Format:
First line: n p x
Second line: n space-separated node values

Output Format:
Space-separated values of modified doubly linked list
